policy.process: Review all sources; finish adaptations; coordinated check; isolated Desktop acceptance; audited packages; commit/push/CI.
policy.rules: Never overwrite sessions, restart a running host, silently downgrade or treat reference/external services as an installed upgrade.
policy.incrementalAcquisition: Compare against preceding review, download only newly changed versions/content, reuse unchanged dependency caches, remove temporary snapshots/profiles/logs/old releases after acceptance; retain current source, LATEST and necessary locks; project target below 1 GB.
